accepted.sentence: A raised sail houses access hatches and retractable equipment above the main hull.
Horizontal diving planes alter pitch and help control depth, while vertical rudders steer the craft.
Sound-absorbing tiles on the outer casing reduce noise radiated into surrounding water.
An extendable snorkel admits air and vents exhaust while the vessel travels just below the surface.
Sealed torpedo tubes launch weapons and can also release underwater listening devices.
Electrolyzers replenish breathable oxygen, while chemical scrubbers remove carbon dioxide from sealed living spaces.
A pressure-lock escape trunk allows crew members to leave through a controlled sequence of sealed hatches.
The compact control room groups navigation displays, steering controls, and machinery indicators within easy reach.
